zones.name: Core Server Zone
zones.description: Domain controllers, file server, mail, web portal, log collector, NTP

zones.name: Data Zone (PHI/PCI)
zones.description: Patient databases, EHR application, billing database, pharmacy app
zones.notes: HIPAA regulated. No direct internet access. All external transfers must proxy through SERVERS.

zones.name: Clinical Workstation Zone
zones.description: Clinical workstations across Main Campus and North Clinic

zones.name: Billing Department Zone
zones.description: Billing workstations, insurance claims, payment processing
zones.notes: PCI DSS scope. Segmented from CLINICAL.

zones.name: IT Administration Zone
zones.description: IT admin workstations, SOC workstation, CI/CD sandbox, vulnerability scanner
zones.notes: Admin zone has broad outbound access for management. Privileged accounts expected.

zones.name: Radiology Server Zone
zones.notes: Receives DICOM transfers from medical devices. PHI in transit.

zones.name: Medical Device Zone
zones.description: MRI scanners, CT scanner, infusion pump controller
zones.notes: Vendor-managed devices with limited patching. Outbound restricted to RADIOLOGY only. Any INTERNET-bound traffic from this zone is a critical alert.

zones.name: On-Call Remote Zone
zones.description: On-call laptops that connect via VPN
zones.notes: Traffic arrives through VPN gateway. Source IPs are VPN-assigned.

zones.name: Perimeter / Demilitarized Zone
zones.description: Edge firewalls, IDS sensor, VPN gateway

zones.name: External / Untrusted
zones.description: All external networks. Catch-all for IPs not matching any internal zone.

inter_zone_rules.notes: Medical devices must never reach the internet directly
PHI/PCI data zone has no direct internet path
Workstations cannot directly reach medical devices
PCI and PHI segments are isolated from each other
No inbound internet to data zone
Inbound internet only through DMZ services
